prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic live-action footage, fixed close camera with the physical cause visible. Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. A real irregular stone is thrown across a small outdoor stonework area and strikes a rough slate slab, with a few chips and loose grit scattering. Capture the incoming air and natural solid impact. A heavy rock strikes a strong stone slab with a deep dense thud and a crisp short fracture, followed by numerous small gravel impacts; no cinematic explosion.
